summary: News Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 23, 2026, furnishing routine daily ASX disclosures tied to its existing stock repurchase program, under which the Company may acquire up to $1 billion in aggregate of its Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. No new authorization, price, or premium was stated; Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 simply reproduce the buyback notices provided to the Australian Securities Exchange on the noted dates. No board recommendation or advisor is cited. The filing reflects ongoing open-market repurchase mechanics rather than a discrete event, so the risk-arb angle is minimal, with the watch item being actual repurchase pace and remaining program capacity.
